Name: Nongshim Chapagetti Original Noodles 140 gm
LongDescription: Chapagetti combines thick, chewy noodles with a savory black bean paste sauce, delivering a sweet and hearty taste reminiscent of traditional Jjajangmyeon. The product includes vegetable flakes such as carrot and onion, enhancing both flavor and texture. rnrnIngredients:rnNoodles: Wheat flour, potato starch, palm oil, salt, seasoning (rice oil, sugar, sweetener: E420, emulsifier: E322 [contains soy]), acidity regulators (E501, E339, E500), tocopherol liquid (antioxidant: E306, emulsifier: E322 [contains soy]), green tea extract (oligosaccharides, tea catechin, acidifier: E330), colorant: E101.rnSoup Powder: Seasoning (soybean paste, corn flour, onions, maltodextrin, salt, palm oil, wheat, shrimp), sugar, caramel powder (maltodextrin, colorant: E150c), flavor enhancers (E631, E627), salt.rnSeasoning Oil: Vegetable oil (rapeseed, olive oil, corn, peanuts, sesame, mustard), onions.rnFlakes: Textured vegetable protein (defatted soybeans, glucose, wheat gluten), cabbage, fried potato (potato, palm oil), onions, carrots.rnrnCooking Process:rnBoil 600 ml of water.rnAdd the noodles and vegetable flakes to the boiling water.rnCook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.rnRemove from heat and drain the water, leaving approximately 8 tablespoons (120 ml).rnAdd the soup powder and seasoning oil to the noodles, stirring well to combine.rnServe hot.rnrnUse: Chapagetti is ideal for a quick and satisfying meal, suitable for lunch, dinner, or a hearty snack.rnrnBenefits:rnConvenience: Ready in approximately 5 minutes, requiring only boiling water.rnFlavor: Offers a rich, savory taste with a blend of black bean paste and spices.rnTexture: Features thick, chewy noodles that enhance the eating experience.rnrnBrand : NongshimrnNet Weight : 140 grams per pack.
